glossary.customer: Consumer customers only exist as CustomerKey on FactInternetSales; no customer dimension is loaded in this deployment.
glossary.profit: Approximated as SalesAmount - TotalProductCost (no explicit profit column is stored).

columns.Class: Quality tier classification of the product (e.g. L=Low, M=Medium, H=High).
columns.DaysToManufacture: Lead time in days required to manufacture one unit.
columns.EndDate: Date this product record stopped being effective (NULL if still active).
columns.FinishedGoodsFlag: 1 if the product is a sellable finished good, 0 if it is a component.
columns.ListPrice: Manufacturer's suggested retail list price per unit.
columns.ModelName: Product model family name; groups size/color variants of the same model.
columns.ProductAlternateKey: Natural business product code (SKU) from the source system.
columns.ProductKey: Surrogate primary key uniquely identifying a product.
columns.ProductLine: High-level product line code (e.g. R=Road, M=Mountain, T=Touring, S=Standard).
columns.ProductSubcategoryKey: Key of the product subcategory this product belongs to (grouping key).
columns.ReorderPoint: Inventory level at which the product should be reordered.
columns.StartDate: Date this product record became effective.
columns.Status: Current lifecycle status of the product (e.g. Current, Discontinued).
columns.Style: Target fit/style of the product (e.g. U=Unisex, M=Men's, W=Women's).

DimProduct.description: Product dimension. One row per product sold by AdventureWorks, including pricing, cost, physical attributes and lifecycle status.

columns.CustomerKey: Identifier of the purchasing consumer customer.
columns.DiscountAmount: Discount amount applied to the line.
columns.DueDate: Calendar date the order was due.
columns.DueDateKey: Integer YYYYMMDD key for the due date.
columns.InternetSalesKey: Surrogate primary key of the sales order line.
columns.OrderDate: Calendar date the order was placed.
columns.OrderDateKey: Integer YYYYMMDD key for the order date.
columns.OrderQuantity: Number of units ordered on this line.
columns.ProductKey: Product sold on this line (foreign key to DimProduct).
columns.ProductStandardCost: Standard cost per unit at time of sale.
columns.PromotionKey: Identifier of the promotion/discount campaign applied, if any.
columns.SalesAmount: Net revenue recognized for this line. Primary revenue measure.
columns.SalesTerritoryKey: Identifier of the sales territory/region attributed to the order.
columns.ShipDateKey: Integer YYYYMMDD key for the ship date.
columns.TotalProductCost: Total standard cost for the line (ProductStandardCost * OrderQuantity).
columns.UnitPriceDiscountPct: Discount percentage applied to the unit price.

FactInternetSales.description: Direct-to-consumer online ('Internet channel') sales order lines. Grain: one row per sales order line.

columns.DiscountAmount: Discount amount applied to the line.
columns.DueDate: Calendar date the order was due.
columns.DueDateKey: Integer YYYYMMDD key for the due date.
columns.EmployeeKey: Identifier of the AdventureWorks sales employee who owns the order.
columns.OrderDate: Calendar date the order was placed.
columns.OrderDateKey: Integer YYYYMMDD key for the order date.
columns.OrderQuantity: Number of units ordered on this line.
columns.ProductKey: Product sold on this line (foreign key to DimProduct).
columns.ProductStandardCost: Standard cost per unit at time of sale.
columns.PromotionKey: Identifier of the promotion/discount campaign applied, if any.
columns.ResellerKey: Identifier of the reseller/dealer that purchased the product.
columns.ResellerSalesKey: Surrogate primary key of the sales order line.
columns.SalesAmount: Net revenue recognized for this line. Primary revenue measure.
columns.SalesTerritoryKey: Identifier of the sales territory/region attributed to the order.
columns.ShipDateKey: Integer YYYYMMDD key for the ship date.
columns.TotalProductCost: Total standard cost for the line (ProductStandardCost * OrderQuantity).
columns.UnitPriceDiscountPct: Discount percentage applied to the unit price.

FactResellerSales.description: B2B sales order lines sold through reseller/dealer partners ('Reseller channel'). Grain: one row per sales order line.
